content.text: Looking at the LDP ontology (
https://www.w3.org/ns/ldp.rdf

), I see that none of the four interaction models supported by Fedora (ldp:NonRDFSource, ldp:BasicContainer, ldp:DirectContainer and ldp:IndirectContainer), are subtypes of any of the others.  Since we do not allow creation of resources with types ldp:Resource, ldp:RDFSource, or ldp:Container, there is no valid change.
So I think the only work to be done here is
(returning a 409 Conflict if a client attempts to change the interaction model).
, do you agree with my analysis here?  If so, I think we can close this ticket and leave returning error codes to

Hm, I think given the current LDP ontology, the relevant specification of the spec is essentially implying that the server must not allow a client to change the interaction model after a resource is created.  So I agree, that means nothing to do here.

— if that's the case, then that's a big breaking change from past practice (where one way to create DirectContainers or IndirectContainers was to create a BasicContainer and then PATCH it to add the type and related parameters).  I'm going to update the Delta document to call this out.
Do you think it's worth escalating to the spec group at large, to verify that the spec truly mandates that interaction effectively models shouldn't change?
— Sure, I'll file an issue for that, since it wasn't obvious to me until I started digging into it.
I've created a spec issue for this:
https://github.com/fcrepo/fcrepo-specification/issues/229
? Any reason not to close this ticket?
I'm not sure.  Was this rendered moot somehow?  I see the specification issue was closed, but without explanation.  I don't see that anything else has changed.

Is it still the case that the either (a) current behaviour of the modeshape impl that allows turning a BasicContainer into a DirectContainer via PATCH needs to be disallowed, or (b) the LDP headers need to be less specific, and just say "Container" or "RDFSource"?
I believe the resolution to this ticket is to change the process by which Direct and Indirect Containers are created.

Currently, when an RdfSource is created, it is automatically created as a BasicContainer. Subsequently, users add triples to that container giving it another type, such as DirectContainer or IndirectContainer.

The task of this ticket should be to allow the current BasicContainer behavior to continue, but allow the creation of Direct and Indirect Containers via the create request and "Link: <type>" approach:
https://fcrepo.github.io/fcrepo-specification/#ldpnr-ixn-model
Changing the type of BasicContainers should be disallowed.
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1298
This work looks good.
Pending response to one code review comment related to an apparently invalid test.
